finding.message: Use equals() to compare object references.

individualStaticClassifications.reason: Reference identity is required for Throwable graph node reachability and cycle avoidance. Calling arbitrary Throwable.equals would merge distinct nodes or recurse; both directions are checked before suppression.

finding.message: Ensure that resources like this SeekableByteChannel object are closed after use

reviewedFindings.reason: FaultIo creates delegate and returns a SeekableByteChannel wrapper whose close closes the same delegate before injecting a close error. Main consumes returned wrapper with ResourceScope.acquire and SeekableByteChannel::close. Closing delegate in factory finally would invalidate the returned capability. Existing channels list records assertions, not a second owning capability. Unchecked allocation failure is not declared as a tested success path.

A descriptor removed between list and readlink is already closed, so it cannot be an open FD leak for that inode at read time. Only NoSuchFileException is ignored; other IO failures propagate and the list stream is try-with-resources. Comment explicitly records concurrent snapshot rationale. This source argument is not actual procfs or native measurement.
